messages:
Alex W: Hey @Sam (Acme) — can you grab the request/trace ID for the failing call? We need a req-ref or debug token to correlate logs.
Mira S: Quick checklist I usually send customers: minimal curl + any SDK console logs + a HAR (browser) or debug token (mobile). Will paste quick commands.
support-bot: Reminder: include the timestamp window (±2 min) and region if known.
Sam (Acme): I can do curl but not sure where the header is coming from in our stack. Our app is a webview inside Android.
Mira S: For webview -> mobile embed: open the SDK dev menu (long-press top-right or enable dev flag) -> tap "Share debug token". That copies a short debug token string like `dbg_ABC123`. Send that and the approximate timestamp.
Mira S: If you can't open the dev menu, repro through Chrome on desktop and grab a HAR: Chrome DevTools -> Network -> reproduce -> right-click -> Save all as HAR with content. Attach the HAR.
Mira S: Example minimal curl we ask for (replace keys):
```
curl -v \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY>' \
  -H 'X-Req-Ref: <if-your-client-adds-one>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4x", "input":"hello"}'
```
Mira S: If you don't see X-Req-Ref, look for headers named `x-rd-reqid`, `x-request-id`, or in SDK logs: `req_ref=`. Example SDK log line we look for: `INFO outgoing_request req_ref=3f9a2b region=us-west model=gpt-4x duration_ms=512`
Sam (Acme): Gotcha. Where in the Console do I copy the debug token?
Mira S: In Redwood Console -> Sessions -> find the recent session (use the timestamp) -> click the kebab menu on the session -> "Copy debug token". It looks like `dbg:eyJ...`. If you prefer, open the Request details and copy the top-right "Debug token" button.
Mira S: What to include when you send it: 1) debug token OR HAR/curl, 2) approximate timestamp + timezone, 3) region (us-west/eu-central), 4) failing endpoint (e.g., /v1/generate), 5) any error messages you saw, 6) sanitized request body (remove PII).
Sam (Acme): Sending debug token now: dbg:eyJ-example — attaching a short screenshot of the session too. Also adding the timestamp: 2025-11-02T18:23:11Z, region: us-west.
Alex W: Received — thanks. We'll pull server-side traces for that token and reply back with a correlation.
Mira S: One more tip for proxy-ed webviews: if you have a corporate proxy, the req-ref might be stripped. In that case please also send a small server log snippet around the timestamp showing headers received. Example (redact IPs):
```
2025-11-02T18:23:11Z INFO http incoming path=/v1/generate method=POST headers={"user-agent":"AcmeApp/2.1","x-forwarded-for":"REDACTED","x-rd-reqid":"7c2f9d"}
```
support-bot: If you want, run this quick verification curl to see the returned request id header: `curl -I -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' https://api.redwood.com/v1/health` — check for `x-rd-reqid` in the response headers.
Alex W: Thanks @Sam — we'll escalate to runtime team if we see any internal 5xx or timeout traces. :thumbsup:
